annotations.title: Start OAuth for a remote MCP server

description: Begin the OAuth consent for a server bound as remote. Returns an authorizeUrl that a HUMAN must open in a browser signed in to the SHIP console as the same user this token acts for; the provider returns to the console, which stores the credential. The link is single-use and expires (expiresAt). An agent cannot complete the consent itself. Requires config:write.

returnTo.description: Console path to land on after consent, e.g. /projects/<id>

scope.description: Requested scope; defaults to the server's own hint

serverName.description: Server name as the repository's MCP file declares it (see list_mcp_servers)

name: start_mcp_server_oauth
title: Start OAuth for a remote MCP server
